purpose: Hardware validation of offline feedforward designs for the 7 mm / 10 Hz heart (XZ plane, 8 s, 10 kHz, 0.5 s ramps): OFF (u = r), A (pure-delay lookahead, tau0 = 0.8 ms), C (lookahead + per-axis linear inverse model), OT_ident_nodelay (OptiTrap-type inverse model with identified parameters and no lookahead; added 2026-09-18 21:40). Reference: G:/マイドライブ/Experiment/20260918/measurement_plan/ff_heart/README.md (copied to ff_heart_20260918/REFERENCE_FF_HEART_README.md). Added 2026-09-19: the same heart without compensation at 5 Hz and 7 Hz (ffheart_s7_f5_OFF, ffheart_s7_f7_OFF) to separate the source of the 70-90 Hz residual. Added later on 2026-09-19: 1 Hz and 2 Hz uncompensated hearts (14 s), the stiffness check on y (kcheck_y_S105_6jumps), and acquisition-side YZ-plane variants of the uncompensated hearts (swap_axes). Added 2026-09-20: w-compensated hearts from the latest model (OFFW = r - w, CW = C - w) at 7 Hz and 10 Hz, and design C at 7 Hz as their comparison arm (source G:/Experiment/20260919/measurement_plan/ff_heart). Added 2026-09-20: the w-field surface scans (wscan_*, spirals in the XZ, YZ, XY and y = +/-4 mm planes, 14 s, no compensation) from G:/Experiment/20260919/measurement_plan/w_scan. Added 2026-09-21: the stage-2 w designs at 7 Hz (OFFWxz / CWxz leave the out-of-plane y uncompensated, OFFW2 / CW2 use the y value back-calculated from the resonant response).
import_note: The heart commands are imported numerically unchanged from ff_heart_20260918/source/*.npz (copies of the G: drive files; positions_sha256 pins the float64 content of positions_mm). Regenerating them with reference_make_ff_heart.py on another OS reproduces the command only to about 3e-10 mm, so the reviewed files themselves are imported. The acquisition side applies no feedforward, clipping, or rescaling; a command above safety_limits is rejected. delay_feedforward_applied=false in the export manifest therefore means 'nothing added at acquisition', while designs A and C already contain feedforward designed offline (see feedforward_design).
naming_note: OFF, A and C keep the run names under which they were recorded on 2026-09-18 (sessions 20:13, 20:59 and 21:20). With the default output folder stereo_acoustools_3d_records_ff_heart the run-directory descriptor may be at most 63 characters before the Windows path budget replaces its end with a hash. ffheart_s7_f10_C_delay_inverse needs 66, so the two recorded C runs are in folders named feedforward_validation_004_ffheart_s7_f10_C_delay_in_af5d3e6291_<timestamp>; the full label is in pipeline_manifest.json. Designs added later use the short form ffheart_<design> so that the design name stays in the folder name.
protocol_note: Proposed order OFF -> A -> C -> C -> A -> OFF with a constant interval, each heart run sandwiched by the two short stiffness checks (kcheck_x / kcheck_z: 1.05 mm, 6 jumps, 2.0 s holds, 14 s) because the trap stiffness droops 25-35% in 10 minutes of operation. Use --hf-run LABEL=SCALE to repeat labels in order, or run_ff_heart_validation.ps1.

experiments.note: Heart 7 mm, 7 Hz, 8 s, design OFFWxz: r minus the w field with the out-of-plane y component left out (make_w_compensation.py --axes xz). Added to the plan on 2026-09-21 from G:/Experiment/20260919/measurement_plan/ff_heart (w_field/W_FIELD_3D_PLAN.md stage 2). On 2026-09-20 the in-plane compensation worked (x resonance band -63%) while the out-of-plane y band got worse (0.17 -> 0.74 mm), because the fine y part of the slowly measured w was measurement bias, not a real trap offset. These four separate the two: the xz runs leave y uncompensated, the 2 runs use the y value back-calculated from the resonant response. Record them in the same session, right after a rest and the stiffness checks, so the thermal state matches. The command departs from r by up to 0.323 mm and leaves y at zero.
